title: Question 21
passage:
Who should I call about this faulty pressure gauge?
A. The pressure reading is still on the screen. B. It was installed earlier this week. C. Nina from equipment maintenance can help.
passageZh:
這個壓力表故障了，我該找誰？
A. 畫面上還顯示著壓力讀數。
B. 這個星期稍早就裝好了。
C. 設備維護部門的 Nina 可以幫忙。
